name: @r4-adapters/identity-verification
description: R4-J4 SEC-OTP channel identity verification (outside R4 Core). SEC-S1: pure classifier of inbound text while a verification is pending (no I/O). SEC-S2: transient state in its own schema identity_verification (expectations, sealed responses, leases and fencing, expiry and purge) and AES-256-GCM SecretBox with key ids and rotation; no plaintext code is ever stored. No channel or provider names; not wired to any ingress; no CIA calls.
